component.name: TuneMesh
component.summary: Play and download music in a library synced by Syncthing

description.p: TuneMesh is a music player for your own collection. The library is an ordinary folder that Syncthing keeps the same on your computers and phones, so songs, playlists and likes follow you everywhere without a server or an account.

ul.li: Browse albums, artists and playlists, search as you type, and keep a play queue
Like songs and build playlists; changes sync to every device
Paste links or search text to download music: one device per library does the downloading and the songs arrive everywhere
Import whole playlists and albums from YouTube, YouTube Music and Spotify links
A setup assistant shares the library folder through Syncthing and adds your other devices
Media keys and desktop media controls through MPRIS

description.p: TuneMesh also has an Android app that reads the same library.
